w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Redactor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Chorus Line, Glasswing Darter, Dustboar, The Callback) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ AD BREAK! You're on your own.

w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Cancellation is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Guizhen opens the pantry wide: 17× Cattail. Larry, Salvador, Zoltan, Hassan eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−2,040 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast —
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The sky, clearing its throat. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Contract Quill. It has signed three leases, two loans, and one terrible contract you still regret. The penmanship was always excellent. The judgment, less so. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they know your hands. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
👁️ Lucas freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Larry: "Smell that? Something's different here."

firstContext: Drank clean water.
Travel 1 tile to grove.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 👁️ A frightened family cornered Larry. "Nice village. Be a shame if something happened to it."
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 💡 Wild Onion: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
💧 The cistern's recovered — full cups again, and nobody's guarding the dipper.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 22 · Craft 7 · Talk 16 · Explore 29 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Salvador Lugo ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
